_comment: Generated by scripts/convert_coupled_limits_v2.py from the files named in sources; do not edit the numbers here, change the source and convert again.
NOT enforced by the model or by the walking environment by default. Angles in degrees (offsets from the rest pose); left-written, the right side uses the same numbers.
Strict-side readings (ambiguity fixes M2, M4, M5) as in convert_coupled_limits.py; rule F (arm_head) reads the smallest cap of the grid nodes around the pose.
